decisions.statement: The question is not whether an agent can categorize but where that agent can be trusted to.
The question is whether an agent knows when that agent cannot be trusted to categorize.
An agent trusted past its reach spends Jenny's attention on corrections rather than on questions.
No single accuracy figure is reported.
The report delivered is the partition.
Coverage and reliability are reported together within each part.
A row a standing rule reaches is not this project's subject.
A row with no category anyone chose has no answer to be scored against.
The rows with no category anyone chose are the rows this pipeline most exists to serve.
The held-out split is a hash of the transaction's own id rather than a stored shuffle.
The prompt is built and revised against the development pool alone.
The held-out pool is read once.
A second reading of the held-out pool is refused rather than trusted to anyone's memory.
A figure taken after a first figure had been seen is reported as a rerun in its own output.
Strata are declared from category names and Alan's recorded rulings.
No stratum is declared from the agent's scores.
The agent is shown both the merchant title and the bank's own words.
A transaction's note is withheld.
Monarch's review flag is withheld as bookkeeping on this history rather than evidence of a purchase.
Uncategorized is not offered.
Confidence is the single channel for doubt.
The Monarch pages are marked before a run and again after.
Both marks land in the result file.
Nothing is applied.
Monarch is not contacted at all.
A call's cost is read back off the call rather than derived from a rate card.
No rate card is kept here.
A run spends money and keeps its whole result.
Scoring reads that result.
Nothing on a transaction records who set its category.
A row Monarch's own categorizer set reads identically to a row Jenny chose.
A split's category belongs to a part of the transaction rather than to the whole.
The transaction an agent is shown underdescribes the split categorized.

definition: how far an agent can be trusted to settle a transaction's category, and where it cannot

directives.name: A Bought Number Means Nothing
directives.act: Leave a fault in the agent unfixed where the fix writes this history's answers into the prompt.
directives.warrant: A score taken after the answer key was copied in describes this history rather than the next row.
aids: Repair the instrument where it is faulty and leave the subject alone.
Say in the report which of the two a change was.
Take a prompt decision on the development pool or not at all.
